messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — low-key idea for today: noon mini 'triathlon' at the office + nearby crag. 5k run or brisk walk (loop by the river), 30–45m bouldering session at GravityWorks, then smoothies in the kitchen. :banana: :muscle: @here who’s in?
Kevin O'Neill: Love this. I can run + belay for boulder folks. What time do we meet?
Asha Patel: In for boulder only — got a client call at 12:15 so I’ll swing by ~12:45.
Maria Chen: Cool — thinking meet at 11:50 in lobby if you want to run, otherwise meet at GravityWorks at 12:10. Adjustable.
Tom Rivera: I’ll do the run. Can someone bring a spare crash pad?
Jonah Kim: I’ve got one in my car. Also bringing chalk.
Lisa Park: Smoothie station sounds great — I can bring banana/berries/almond milk. Anyone allergic to nuts?
Kevin O'Neill: Not me. :+1:
Asha Patel: I’m allergic to tree nuts — thanks for checking, Lisa.
Maria Chen: Thanks Asha — Lisa, can you do one nut-free option? :pray:
Lisa Park: Yep — nut-free smoothie option on deck.
devops-bot: Reminder: lunch-plans channel has a permanent rule about shared food — please label ingredients.
Maria Chen: Good call — will label everything. Also proposal: short scoreboard bracket for fun — record one PR (fastest 5k split or hardest boulder topout) and we’ll hand out a tiny trophy (knot of climbing tape). Anyone want to keep score?
Jonah Kim: I can time the run and jot down grades. Simple spreadsheet?
Kevin O'Neill: Throwing a lightweight sign-up here:```
1) Run + boulder
2) Run only
3) Boulder only
4) Smoothie + moral support
```
Tom Rivera: 1
Kevin O'Neill: 1
Asha Patel: 3
Lisa Park: 4 (smoothie chef)
Jonah Kim: 1
Maria Chen: 1 (will label and bring extra water)
devops-bot: Deploy-bot: nothing to deploy, enjoy the workout. :rocket:
Kevin O'Neill: Anyone want to do a warmup reminder? 10 min dynamic stretches before running and 5–10 easy climbs before trying hard moves.
Maria Chen: Yup — team warmup at 11:50 in lobby for runners, 12:05 at the gym for climbers. Short and safe.
Tom Rivera: Thanks all — see you at the loop. If it rains we move smoothies + boulder at GravityWorks only.
Lisa Park: I’ll bring napkins and a small knife for fruit prep. Labeling: 'contains berries, almond milk' and 'nut-free: banana+oat milk'
Asha Patel: Perfect. See y’all later!
Kevin O'Neill: :sunglasses:
